create_SMPLRenderer: create an SMPLRenderer instance to render 3D mesh models with configurable image size and focal length
render_SMPL_mesh: render SMPL mesh vertices into an RGB image using camera parameters and optional background image
rotate_and_render_mesh: rotate SMPL mesh vertices around x, y, or z axis by specified degrees then render to image
render_model_with_alpha: render a 3D mesh model with transparent alpha channel for white background images
render_model_on_background: render a 3D mesh model overlaid on a custom background image with alpha compositing
